scope: Free-field 4-microphone simulation, one LibriSpeech speaker for both talkers, 8 s per run after 1 s target-muted noise calibration; first 1 s excluded. MVDR (loading 0.01) for all steered methods except crossing_talker (delay-and-sum); SNR gain is relative to the unsteered front-pair reference. 'known' uses the true target angle (upper bound). 'track_lock' is told the target direction once at t = 0 (user designation); 'dominant' and 'track_speech' receive no direction. Steering quantized to 1 degree. Not a perceptual or clinical result.

scenarios.loud_noise: target 30 deg; stationary low-pass noise at -70 deg; -5 dB SNR
scenarios.moving_target: target sweeps -45 to +45 deg at 11.25 deg/s; noise at 150 deg; 0 dB SNR
scenarios.two_talkers: target talker 30 deg; second passage (same speaker) at -60 deg; 0 dB SNR
scenarios.crossing_talker: target talker 0 deg; second passage moves -90 to +90 deg at 22.5 deg/s, crossing at 4 s; 0 dB SNR; delay-and-sum (a moving masker invalidates the calibrated MVDR statistics)
